title: E Sharam Card Online Registration 2022
postName: e-Shram Card / Universal Account Number for unorganised workers
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit https://eshram.gov.in
2. Self registration with Aadhaar and mobile
3. Fill occupation and personal details
4. Complete e-KYC
5. Download e-Shram card / UAN
shortDescription: e-Shram Card Online Registration – free national database card for unorganised workers on eshram.gov.in.
content:
e-Shram is the national database of unorganised workers. Registration is free and provides a Universal Account Number (UAN) card.

Workers aged 16–59 in unorganised sector can register with Aadhaar. Portal: eshram.gov.in.
